reuse.why: Linking reuses the existing ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount like the other providers, but the download side writes a new downloadFintegraTransactions instead of sharing the identical Akahu/Pluggy download logic.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a condensed copy of downloadAkahuTransactions (token, post, error check, response mapping), and types/models/index.ts gets the same fintegra re-export twice.

placement.why: Link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in accounts/sync.ts, base path in server-config.ts and types under types/models, mirroring existing providers.

scope.why: Focused on Fintegra, with a small unrelated widening of DbAccount.account_sync_source to all providers and a duplicated export line.

maintainability.why: The link path is consistent, but another hand-copied download function (missing the 'error' in res branch the siblings have) and passing institution as a bare string unlike the other providers' {name} object add drift.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions in accounts/sync.ts reshapes downloadAkahuTransactions (destructured response, compressed post call, one error branch dropped) under a new name.
